asA: builder writing production code and code-hygiene unit tests
iWant: hygiene tests under a hygiene/ directory to class as mine, outside the RCF suite
soThat: I can keep code hygiene without crossing into the test-author's RCF tests, and coverage never counts a hygiene test for a criterion
description: The builder hygiene class (Q-01 a, D-13 amended).
title: A builder writes hygiene unit tests that the audit classes as builder-owned and the RCF suite never counts

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a fixture commit "BUILD: hygiene" touching src/a.js, test/hygiene/a.test.js, packages/x/test/hygiene/b.test.js and src/a.hygiene.test.js, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 0, the commit counts under BUILD, and its --json row lists classes production and hygieneTest only.

[failure] Given a fixture commit "DEFINE: tests" touching test/hygiene/a.test.js, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 4 with the item "<s7> DEFINE: touches test/hygiene/a.test.js (class hygieneTest, owned by BUILD)".

[failure] Given a fixture chain whose AC-101-1 is bound only by a test case whose testPointer is test/hygiene/a.test.js::<a passing test name>, when rcf audit coverage --strict runs, then it exits 4, AC-101-1 is reported uncovered, and its row names "hygiene test, outside the RCF suite: test/hygiene/a.test.js"; the same criterion bound to test/rcf/a.test.js::<the same test name> is covered and the run exits 0.

[must-not] Given the fixture chain of the coverage case, when rcf define validate runs, then it exits 0 (a hygiene binding is never a validation error) and stderr carries exactly one line "[warn] TC-<id> points into a hygiene test (test/hygiene/a.test.js); hygiene tests are outside the RCF suite and never count as coverage", and no hygiene test is ever counted toward any criterion's coverage in table, json or mermaid output.

[edge] Given rcf/separation.json {"classes": {"hygieneTest": ["spec/unit/**"]}} at the head, when a "BUILD: unit" commit touches spec/unit/a.js and a "DEFINE: spec" commit touches spec/unit/b.js, then rcf audit separation exits 4 naming only the DEFINE commit with "(class hygieneTest, owned by BUILD)"; the BUILD commit passes.
